# `ptfkit.wang2022`

```cpp
import ptfkit.wang2022;
```

**Exported namespace:** `ptfkit::wang2022`

Wang et al. (2022), random-forest PTFs for soil hydraulic-model parameters.

## Source

Wang, Y., Zhou, J., Ma, R., Zhu, G., & Zhang, Y. (2022). Development of a New Pedotransfer Function Addressing Limitations in Soil Hydraulic Models and Observations. Water Resources Research, 58, e2021WR031406.

[DOI: 10.1029/2021WR031406](https://doi.org/10.1029/2021WR031406)

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/wang2022.md)

## `Wang2022PTFResult`

```cpp
struct Wang2022PTFResult {
    double alpha;
    double n;
    double m;
    double theta_s;
    double k_sat;
    double sl;
};
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `alpha` | van Genuchten inverse pressure-scale parameter. (cm⁻¹) |
| `n` | van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter. (dimensionless) |
| `m` | van Genuchten retention-curve shape parameter. (dimensionless) |
| `theta_s` | Saturated volumetric soil water content. (cm³ cm⁻³) |
| `k_sat` | Saturated hydraulic conductivity. (cm day⁻¹) |
| `sl` | Source-defined soil hydraulic slope parameter. (dimensionless) |

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_wang2022_h2` {#function-calc_ptf_wang2022_h2}

Estimate six soil hydraulic-model parameters from sand, silt, and clay with the published H2 random forests.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline Wang2022PTFResult calc_ptf_wang2022_h2(double sand, double silt, double clay)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sand` | Sand content by mass. (%) |
| `silt` | Silt content by mass. (%) |
| `clay` | Clay content by mass. (%) |

#### Returns

A `Wang2022PTFResult` value.

!!! note

    The proposed public contract accepts texture in percent and divides each value by 100 before passing predictors to the serialized models.

!!! note

    The serialized models predict log10(alpha), log10(n), log10(m), and log10(Ks); official code applies 10 raised to each prediction. Theta_s and SL are emitted directly.

!!! note

    Predictor order is sand, silt, clay and must be preserved exactly.

!!! warning

    The supplied source describes texture as article percentages but the executable workbook and code use fractions summing to one. This API makes that boundary explicit by accepting percent and dividing by 100.

### `calc_ptf_wang2022_h3` {#function-calc_ptf_wang2022_h3}

Estimate six soil hydraulic-model parameters from texture and bulk density with the published H3 random forests.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline Wang2022PTFResult calc_ptf_wang2022_h3(double sand, double silt, double clay, double bulk_density)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `sand` | Sand content by mass. (%) |
| `silt` | Silt content by mass. (%) |
| `clay` | Clay content by mass. (%) |
| `bulk_density` | Dry bulk density used by the H3 random-forest models. (g/cm^3) |

#### Returns

A `Wang2022PTFResult` value.

!!! note

    The serialized models predict log10(alpha), log10(n), log10(m), and log10(Ks); official code applies 10 raised to each prediction. Theta_s and SL are emitted directly.

!!! note

    Predictor order is sand, silt, clay, bulk density and must be preserved exactly.

!!! warning

    The supplied source describes texture as article percentages but the executable workbook and code use fractions summing to one. This API makes that boundary explicit by accepting percent and dividing by 100.
